title: 第1506章 魏坤暴怒兄妹准备加更第1505章 父亲他动手了
content_zh:
执法殿中枢，魏坤原本正在处理公务，警报声和空间波动传来的瞬间，他猛地站起身，脸色铁青。
“废物！一群废物！”魏坤怒喝一声，强大的气息冲天而起，“竟然让人在我执法殿眼皮底下盗走重宝！查！给我查！是谁干的！”
他身形一动，便要亲自追出去，但刚一靠近虚空乱流阵的范围，便感受到了空间的极度不稳定。
“虚空乱流阵？好手段！”魏坤眼中杀机毕露，“想走？没那么容易！”
他正要强行破开阵法，就在此时，数道隐晦却不弱的气息从侧面袭来，虽然力量不足以威胁到他，但时机拿捏得极为精准，正好阻住了他的去路。
“象征性的阻击么？”魏坤冷笑，他瞬间便看穿了对方的意图，“秦延军，是你！”他几乎立刻就猜到了幕后黑手。
除了这个一直对自己阳奉阴违，且野心勃勃的家伙，他想不出第二个人。
魏坤随手一挥，便将那股隐藏力量击溃，但这短暂的迟滞，已经给死士们争取了宝贵的时间。他们已经冲出了虚空乱流阵的范围，消失在夜色之中。
“秦延军！你敢对付我！对付道君！”魏坤怒吼，声音传遍了整个二十八重天，“传令下去，封锁所有出口，搜捕秦延军及其党羽！夺回重宝！”
……
秦延军的密室中，他收到了死士成功撤离并带着至宝返回安全据点的消息，紧绷的神经终于稍稍放松。
“第一步，成了。”秦延军嘴角露出一丝欣慰的笑容，但眼中的决绝并未减少，“魏坤，这只是开始。”
他知道，魏坤已经猜到是他，接下来将是狂风暴雨般的搜捕。但他早已将后路安排妥当。
而此刻，隐匿在暗处的秦思宇三兄妹，看到魏坤暴怒却又无可奈何的样子，心中悬着的石头也落了地。
“父亲真的做到了！”秦思浩低声道，语气中充满了敬佩。
秦思涵也松了口气：“我们现在怎么办？回去继续闭关，还是……”
秦思宇摇了摇头：“不了，既然父亲已经行动，我们也不能再置身事外。从今天起，我们随时准备接应父亲，为那最终的目标，贡献我们的力量！”
他望向秦延军密室的方向，眼中闪烁着坚定的光芒。
夜色依旧深沉，但秦延军的计划已然成功了关键的第一步。
他不仅得到阻止启动“诛神阵”的关键材料，更向魏坤，向那高高在上的无情道君，发出了第一声挑战的号角。

二十八重天的平静被彻底打破，一场席卷整个界域的风暴，正在悄然酝酿。
秦延军的棋盘，已经落下了惊世骇俗的第一子。而他的三个儿女，也在这一刻，正式踏入了这波澜壮阔的棋局之中。
魏坤府邸的怒火几乎要冲破云霄。
“废物！一群废物！全都是废物！”魏坤猩红着双眼，一掌拍碎了身前的紫檀木案，“封锁全城，挨家挨户给我搜！掘地三尺也要把秦延军给我找出来！还有他那三个孽种，一并拿下！”
他深知，秦延军此举绝非简单的盗宝，而是对他，乃至对无情道君权威的公然挑衅。
那“诛神阵”的关键材料，关乎着道君大人平定叛乱、稳固统治的核心计划，如今被窃，后果不堪设想。
“大人，秦延军狡猾得很，恐怕早已不在城中。而且，动用如此大规模的搜捕，会不会……”一名属下心惊胆战地提醒，他指的是“惊动道君大人”。
魏坤眼中闪过一丝犹豫，但随即被狠厉取代：“哼！事到如今，还顾得上这些？秦延军一日不除，我心难安！立刻传我命令，动用‘天罗地网’大阵，覆盖整个二十八重天！同时，向道君大人呈报，就说秦延军盗取重宝，意图不轨！”
他不敢隐瞒，但也巧妙地将责任推给了秦延军的“意图不轨”，而非自己看守不力。他料定，以无情道君的性子，得知有人敢破坏他的计划，必定雷霆震怒。
这或许会让“诸神阵”的铺开速度加快，但也只能借助道君之手，更快地将秦延军这颗毒瘤铲除。他赌的是，在道君的怒火降临之前，他能先一步掌控局面。
原本还在秘密部署的力量，一夜之间变得半公开化。无数身着黑色甲胄、气息冰冷的“镇神卫”开始在各要道巡查，盘查过往修士，气氛骤然紧张到了极点。
魏坤的目的达到了，但也将整个二十八重天彻底推向了风口浪尖。
与此同时，隐匿在一处秘境中的秦思宇三兄妹，也收到了外界的消息。
“魏坤这老狗，果然狗急跳墙，连天罗地网都用上了，还惊动了无情道君！”秦思浩拳头紧握，脸上满是愤慨。
秦思涵秀眉微蹙：“诸神阵加速铺开，对父亲的行动大大不利。我们必须尽快想办法。”
秦思宇眼神凝重，他知道，真正的考验来了。“魏坤想逼父亲现身，或者困死父亲。他以为这样就能高枕无忧了吗？”
他嘴角勾起一抹冷冽，“既然他不仁，就别怪我们不义。父亲给了我们这些传承神器，就是让我们在关键时刻用的！”
他缓缓抽出背后的“破岳枪”，枪身嗡鸣，似有千军万马奔腾之声；左手虚握，一柄古朴厚重的长剑——“镇渊剑”凭空出现，剑意压得周围空间微微扭曲。“我的破岳枪，能破万法；镇渊剑，可定乾坤。魏坤的爪牙，就用他们来清理！”
秦思涵也动了，手中“星辰鞭”一抖，点点星光洒落，仿佛能引动九天星辰之力；另一手则托着一枚小巧玲珑的神剑——“定神剑”，剑身流淌着符文，散发着裁决一切的气息。“星辰鞭困敌，定神剑诛邪。任何阻碍父亲计划的人，都将受到星辰的审判！”
秦思浩深吸一口气，心念一动，一面巨大的“玄龟盾”横亘在身前，龟甲上纹路流转，散发着坚不可摧的气息；

头顶，一口古老的“东皇钟”缓缓悬浮，钟体铭刻日月星辰，隐隐有镇压诸天的威势；
他手中还捧着一本散发着混沌气息的古籍——“陈道天书”，书页翻动间，似乎有大道符文在闪烁。“我会用玄龟盾为你们防御，东皇钟镇住场面，陈道天书则能推演天机，洞察敌人的弱点和动向。”
三兄妹气势相连，神器共鸣，一股强大的力量在秘境中升腾。他们知道，这些传承自父辈或机缘所得的神器，将是他们手中最锋利的剑，最坚固的盾。

content_en:
At the center of the Law Enforcement Palace, Wei Kun was originally handling official duties. The moment the sirens and space fluctuations were heard, he stood up abruptly, his face ashen.
"Trash! A bunch of trash!" Wei Kun shouted angrily, and a powerful aura rose into the sky, "You actually let someone steal a valuable treasure under the eyes of my law enforcement hall! Check! Check for me! Who did it!"
As soon as he moved, he wanted to chase him out personally, but as soon as he got close to the range of the Void Turbulence Array, he felt the extreme instability of the space.
"Void Turbulence Formation? What a good idea!" Wei Kun's eyes were filled with murderous intent, "Want to leave? It's not that easy!"
He was about to forcefully break the formation, when at this moment, several vague but not weak auras hit him from the side. Although the power was not enough to threaten him, the timing was extremely precise, blocking his way.
"A symbolic block?" Wei Kun sneered. He instantly saw through the other party's intentions, "Qin Yanjun, it's you!" He guessed the mastermind almost immediately.
He couldn't think of another person besides this guy who had always been obedient to him and very ambitious.
Wei Kun defeated the hidden power with a wave of his hand, but this short delay had already bought precious time for the dead soldiers. They had already rushed out of the range of the Void Turbulence Formation and disappeared into the night.
"Qin Yanjun! How dare you deal with me! Deal with Dao Lord!" Wei Kun roared, and his voice spread throughout the twenty-eighth heaven. "Send the order, seal all exits, search for Qin Yanjun and his followers! Take back the treasure!"
…
In Qin Yanjun's secret room, he received the news that the dead soldiers had successfully evacuated and returned to the safe base with the treasure, and his tense nerves finally relaxed a little.
"The first step is done." A smile of relief appeared on Qin Yanjun's lips, but the determination in his eyes did not diminish. "Wei Kun, this is just the beginning."
He knew that Wei Kun had already guessed that it was him, and what would follow would be a violent manhunt. But he had already arranged his escape plan.
At this moment, the three brothers and sisters of Qin Siyu, who were hiding in the dark, saw Wei Kun's furious but helpless look, and the stone hanging in their hearts fell to the ground.
"Father really did it!" Qin Sihao whispered, his tone full of admiration.
Qin Sihan also breathed a sigh of relief: "What should we do now? Go back and continue retreat, or..."
Qin Siyu shook his head: "No, since father has taken action, we can no longer stay aloof. From today on, we are always ready to assist father and contribute our strength to the ultimate goal!"
He looked in the direction of Qin Yanjun's secret room, with a firm light shining in his eyes.
The night was still dark, but Qin Yanjun's plan had succeeded in the crucial first step.
Not only did he obtain the key materials to prevent the activation of the "God-killing Formation", but he also issued the first call of challenge to Wei Kun and the aloof and ruthless Taoist Lord.
The peace of the twenty-eighth heaven was completely broken, and a storm sweeping the entire realm was quietly brewing.
Qin Yanjun's chessboard has already landed a shocking first piece. And his three children also officially entered this magnificent chess game at this moment.
The anger in Wei Kun's mansion almost broke through the sky.
"Trash! A bunch of trash! They are all trash!" Wei Kun's eyes were scarlet, and he smashed the rosewood case in front of him with one palm. "Sign up the whole city and search for me from house to house! I have to dig three feet into the ground to find Qin Yanjun! And capture those three bastards of his!"
He knew very well that Qin Yanjun's move was by no means a simple treasure theft, but a blatant provocation to him and even to the authority of the ruthless Dao Lord.
The key material of the "God-killing Formation" is related to Lord Daojun's core plan to put down the rebellion and stabilize his rule. Now that it has been stolen, the consequences will be disastrous.
"Sir, Qin Yanjun is very cunning. I'm afraid he is no longer in the city. Moreover, if such a large-scale manhunt is launched, will it..." A subordinate reminded in fear. He was referring to "alarming the Tao Lord."people".
A trace of hesitation flashed in Wei Kun's eyes, but was immediately replaced by a fierce tone: "Humph! Now that things have happened, can you still care about this? If Qin Yan's army is not eliminated for a day, I will feel uneasy! Immediately send me an order to use the 'Tian Luo Earth Net' formation to cover the entire twenty-eighth heaven! At the same time, he reported to Lord Dao that Qin Yanjun had stolen a valuable treasure with evil intentions! "
He did not dare to hide it, but he also cleverly shifted the responsibility to Qin Yanjun's "bad intentions" rather than his own poor guarding. He expected that with the ruthless Dao Lord's temperament, he would be furious when he learned that someone dared to sabotage his plan.
This may speed up the rollout of the "Array of Gods", but only with the help of Dao Lord can the cancer of Qin Yanjun be eradicated faster. What he was betting on was that he could take control of the situation before Daojun's wrath descended.
The forces that were originally deployed secretly became semi-public overnight. Countless "Shen Shen Guards" wearing black armor and with cold breaths began to patrol the main roads, checking the passing monks, and the atmosphere suddenly became extremely tense.
Wei Kun's goal was achieved, but it also pushed the entire Twenty-Eighth Heaven to the forefront.
At the same time, the three brothers and sisters of Qin Siyu, who were hiding in a secret place, also received news from the outside world.
"Wei Kun, this old dog, really jumped over the wall in a hurry, even used a dragnet, and even alerted the ruthless Taoist Lord! "Qin Sihao clenched his fists, his face full of indignation.
Qin Sihan frowned slightly: "The array of gods is spreading out at an accelerated pace, which is greatly detrimental to my father's actions. We must find a solution as soon as possible. "
Qin Siyu's eyes were solemn, and he knew that the real test was coming. "Wei Kun wanted to force his father to show up, or to trap him to death. Did he think he could sit back and relax this way? "
There was a hint of coldness in the corner of his mouth, "Since he is unkind, don't blame us for being unjust. Father gave us these inherited artifacts for us to use at critical moments! "
He slowly pulled out the "Poyue Spear" from behind, and the gun buzzed, like the sound of thousands of troops galloping. He held it empty in his left hand, and a simple and heavy long sword - "Zhenyuan Sword" appeared out of thin air, and the sword's intention made the surrounding space slightly distorted. "My Yue-breaking Spear can defeat all kinds of magic; my Yuan-Suppressing Sword can stabilize the world. Use them to clean up Wei Kun's minions! "
Qin Sihan also moved. He shook the "Star Whip" in his hand, and starlight fell, as if it could activate the power of the stars in the nine heavens. In his other hand, he held a small and exquisite divine sword - the "Dingshen Sword". The sword's body was filled with runes, exuding the aura of ruling everything. "The star whip traps the enemy, and the calming sword slays evil spirits. Anyone who stands in the way of Father's plan will be judged by the stars! "
Qin Sihao took a deep breath and thought, a huge "Black Tortoise Shield" lay in front of him, with lines flowing on the tortoise shell, exuding an indestructible aura;
Above the head, an ancient "Eastern Emperor Bell" slowly floats. The bell body is engraved with the sun, moon and stars, and it has the faint power to suppress the heavens;
He was also holding in his hand an ancient book that exuded the aura of chaos - "Chen Dao Heavenly Book". As the pages of the book were turned, there seemed to be avenue runes flickering. "I will use the Black Turtle Shield to defend you, the Donghuang Bell to calm the scene, and the Chen Dao Heavenly Book to deduce the secrets of heaven and gain insight into the enemy's weaknesses and movements. "
The three brothers and sisters are connected in momentum, the artifact resonates, and a powerful force rises in the secret realm. They know that these artifacts inherited from their parents or acquired by chance will be the sharpest swords and strongest shields in their hands.
